<thought>To locate the Wolff‑Kishner reduction template, I will search the template catalog for reactions that break a “ketones” functional group (the forward reaction converts a ketone to an alkane). I will request a larger number of results to increase the chance of finding the correct template.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CC(=O)C",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones"],
    "limit": 20
}</action_input>
